geometry.slot_model: slot = zero-thickness polygon (CSXCAD AddPolygon, norm_dir z, elevation h) of an air Material (eps_r 1, kappa 0) with priority 20 > conducting sheet 10. Verified by reading the installed source: ContinuousStructure::GetPropertyByCoordPriority(coord, primList) returns the first priority-sorted primitive containing the edge coordinate; Operator::CalcPEC_Range and Operator_Ext_ConductingSheet::BuildExtension only act when that winner is METAL/ConductingSheet; Operator::AverageMatCellCenter samples cell centres (never on the z=h plane; drawing tolerance 0), so the zero-thickness air polygon does not alter substrate epsilon. NOT yet exercised in a solve.
geometry.polygon_meshing: round 6 rules (fixed_mesh_lines): 1/3-2/3 metal_edge_res rule on every axis-aligned metal/no-metal edge of patch, slots and line (board-edge coincident edges skipped), bounding-box extremes, plain vertex lines (dropped if < 0.1 mm from a rule/user line), merge of lines < 0.05 mm, merge of facing 'outside' lines < 0.7 * res, optional mesh_hint_lines_mm, bounded relaxation of fixed lines (<= 0.04 mm shift, target ratio 1.3 among fixed cells), then SmoothMeshLines with the ratio parameter lowered until the result is <= 1.4 (SMOOTH_RATIO_SEARCH); target 1.4, hard limit 1.5 (recorded in mesh_ratio_above_1p4_by_axis); staircase on oblique edges

connector_declared_in_variant.modeled: 50 ohm port at board edge y=-13 (reference plane); connector body not modeled

port.description: Launch plane = board edge y = -sy/2 (owner decision: SMA at the board edge, connector body not modelled). Default 'msl': openEMS MSLPort (ports.py MSLPort.__init__ lines 321-417 of the installed source: signature (CSX, port_nr, metal_prop, start, stop, prop_dir, exc_dir, excite, FeedShift, MeasPlaneShift, Feed_R); start=[x-w/2, y_launch, h] stop=[x+w/2, y_meas+1 mm, 0], prop_dir 'y' (+y, direction=sign(stop_y-start_y)), exc_dir 'z'; the metal sheet box is added to the same conducting-sheet property as the patch; E_z soft excitation at the mesh line nearest start+FeedShift; Feed_R=50 ohm lumped resistor across the line at the launch plane absorbs the backward wave; voltage probes at 3 y lines around the measurement plane, current probes between them; MSLPort.ReadUIData lines 419-447 extracts beta=sqrt(-dE dH/(E H)) and Z_line=sqrt(E dE/(H dH)) from them). Post-processing: CalcPort(ref_plane_shift=0) moves U,I from the measurement plane to the launch plane with the transmission-line transform of Port.CalcPort lines 217-227 (real(beta), Z_line, shift = 0 - measplane_shift < 0 = towards the source); then U,I at the launch plane are renormalised to 50 ohm (a = (U + 50 I)/2, b = U - a, S11 = b/a) and Zin = U/I; S11 against the line's own Z_line is also stored. Feed-stub loss between launch plane and measurement plane is NOT included (real beta only; ~0.1 dB expected for ~4 mm of FR4 line, not measured). Fallback 'lumped': vertical 50 ohm LumpedPort on the line end at y = -sy/2, x in [x-w/2, x+w/2], z in [0, h] (same as the openEMS RadarUWBTutorial.py edge-fed monopole, which places its lumped port at the board edge); its U/I are measured directly at the launch plane and include the port's own step discontinuity.
port.type: openEMS MSLPort (quasi-TEM wave separation) + reference-plane shift to the launch plane + renormalisation to 50 ohm
port.reference_plane: board edge y = -size_y/2: U,I moved from the measurement plane with CalcPort(ref_plane_shift=0), real(beta), then renormalised to 50 ohm

far_field.name: nf2ff
far_field.model: openEMS.CreateNF2FFBox(frequency=[...]) (openEMS.pyx lines 464-521; frequency kw selects frequency-domain E/H dumps, nf2ff.py lines 65-80, dump_type 10/11, single-sided DFT weights Common/processfields_fd.cpp lines 103-106, the same single-sided convention as the port probes DFT_time2freq utilities.py lines 27-41, so Prad and port powers are directly comparable as in Tutorials/Helical_Antenna.py line 179 and RadarUWBTutorial.py line 182). Box = the default derived from the PML_8 boundaries: faces on mesh line index 9 / -10 (one cell inside the PML region, in air, outside the board and the substrate; no conductor crosses the box because the SMA/port is inside the board). CalcNF2FF(sim_path, freq, theta, phi, radius=1 m, center in METRES, read_cached=False): E_theta/E_phi include the factor exp(-jkr)/r at r = 1 m (nf2ff_calc.cpp lines 503-513), P_rad = |E|^2/(2 Z0) in W/m^2, Prad = net Poynting flux through the box (nf2ff_calc.cpp line 414, independent of the sampled angles), Dmax = max over the SAMPLED directions only (line 525). Quantities derived here: D = 4 pi r^2 P_rad / Prad; gain (IEEE, excludes mismatch) = 4 pi r^2 P_rad / P_acc; realised gain = 4 pi r^2 P_rad / P_inc (the formula of RadarUWBTutorial.py line 182, Dmax*Prad/P_inc); radiation efficiency = Prad / P_acc with P_acc = 0.5 Re(U I*) at the launch plane (Helical_Antenna.py line 179); total efficiency = Prad / P_inc. Prad contains radiation only; conductor, dielectric and any feed-stub loss are in P_acc - Prad.
far_field.cuts: phi=0/180 (xz plane) and phi=90/270 (yz plane), theta 0..180 every 5 deg
far_field.dmax_caveat: Dmax from openEMS is the maximum over the sampled directions only; D(theta,phi) here uses Prad
far_field.radiated_group_delay: ENABLED_DIAGNOSTIC (11 points): Radiated group delay (only with 11 points): H(f) = E_far(theta=0, phi=0, f) exp(+j k r) / a_inc(f), with a_inc the incident-wave voltage at the launch plane (same reference plane as S11), r = 1 m, k = 2 pi f / c0. E_theta and E_phi of the phi=0 cut are the x and y components at broadside (theta_hat = x_hat, phi_hat = y_hat at phi = 0). tau_g = -d arg(H)/d omega from the unwrapped phase with central differences (one-sided at the ends). The excitation spectrum and its phase cancel; the NF2FF phase centre only adds a constant (z of the centre / c0 at broadside). The absolute value contains the constant electrical length of the line and of the stub; only the variation over the band (ripple) is meaningful. DIAGNOSTIC: not validated against a reference; 49.92 MHz spacing is below the DTFT resolution 1/T_record of the run, so adjacent samples are not independent.
far_field.cpu_note: CalcNF2FF uses numThreads=0 (all hardware threads) but the process runs under taskset <= 2 CPUs
assumptions: PML_8 thin absorber 4 mm (0.1 lambda0) next to the box (box 1 cell inside it, default derived by openEMS); box-to-board distance 17.5 mm = 0.47 lambda0 at f0
near-field box includes the finite 26x26 mm ground and substrate edge fields; no substrate/ground crosses the box faces
